meta.title: Dialogi AI - Sigma CX
meta.description: Dialogi is the empathetic AI platform from SigmaCX for service on WhatsApp, chat, social media and voice: every digital interaction in one place.

hero.lead: Dialogi is the empathetic AI platform from SigmaCX for service on WhatsApp, chat, social media and voice: every digital interaction in one place, reading intent and emotion in each conversation.

voice.alt: Illustrative example of a WhatsApp voice call with real-time sentiment analysis
voice.name: Diana · Dialogi assistant

why.title: Digital service without switching channels.
why.body: Reputation is born in the connection with the customer. Dialogi brings it into a single flow, with context and intent in every conversation.

pillars.title: Every channel in one place
pillars.body: WhatsApp, chat, social media and voice in one queue, without losing history.

pillars.title: Native voice on WhatsApp
pillars.body: Voice calls, audio and video without the customer leaving WhatsApp.

pillars.title: Empathy as a platform layer
pillars.body: empat.ia reads emotion, language and intent and evolves with every interaction.

features.title: What the **platform** does
features.body: From the voice call to identity validation: the features that hold the conversation together end to end.

items.title: Voice call on WhatsApp
items.body: Service that goes beyond chat: talk to the customer on a call, in the same conversation flow.

items.title: Audio message
items.body: More practical for whoever speaks and clearer for whoever answers. Audio in chat means speed and context.

items.title: Transcription and translation
items.body: Audio becomes searchable text, and instant translation removes language barriers on the spot.

items.title: Sentiment analysis
items.body: Reading beyond the words: Dialogi interprets the emotion in the conversation and flags what needs attention.

items.title: Multi Agents
items.body: Several connections and agents in parallel, without losing the human touch in any of them.

items.title: Voice biometrics
items.body: Identity validation by voice: fast, secure authentication with no verification questionnaire.

sectors.title: Built for any **digital service** operation
sectors.body: Below, some of the sectors where Dialogi already operates. Because flows, integrations and automations are configured per operation, the platform is not limited to this list: it serves companies of every size.

items.title: Education
items.body: Enrollment, student records and communication with guardians.

items.title: Financial
items.body: Voice biometrics, personalized service and sentiment analysis.

items.title: Healthcare
items.body: 24/7 service, accessibility and translation, sensitive data management.

items.title: Public services
items.body: High volumes of tickets with a single queue and full traceability.

items.title: Retail
items.body: Omnichannel, cart recovery and segmented campaigns.

open.title: And your sector
open.body: If the operation serves customers on WhatsApp, chat, social media or voice, Dialogi adapts to the process that already exists.

final.titleTrail: has its own site, and that is where the journey continues.
final.body: A platform demo, features in detail, plans by operation size and the help center all live on the Dialogi site.
